title: Epidemiology of Septic Shock in Medical or Polyvalent ICU in the North-East Region of France
brief_summary: The epidemiology of this study aims and outcome of patients with septic shock in the intensive care unit (or versatile) of the North-East region in france as well as the modalities of care.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients in septic shock defined by hypotension that is not reversed by volume resuscitation and requires the use of vasopressors.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
